utility.name: PHP 7.4 patched against php2shell (source build, Debian 10 Buster)
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Builds PHP 7.4 from the upstream php-src branch PHP-7.4-CVE-2026-109618-109619 (pinned to commit 712e60f9edfd03f0960fc4fc3c2c375f42b90aa2) and makes it the default `php` CLI. This branch is the end-of-life source backport that carries the php2shell fix (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619); the released 7.4 packages on deb.sury.org and Debian are end of life and do not. Built on Debian 10 Buster, whose OpenSSL 1.1.1 and toolchain are contemporary with PHP 7.4 (the ext/openssl source does not compile against bookworm's OpenSSL 3.0). The build reports version 7.4.31-dev, so the fix cannot be identified by version string alone; the install records the pinned source commit in a provenance marker (/opt/php-7.4-patched/PHP2SHELL_FIX_COMMIT) for checks to read. For a PHP application that would otherwise run on an end-of-life PHP 7.x and be php2shell-exploitable, require this so only the application's own vulnerability is exploitable.
